posts.name: Sayan Ghosh
posts.cooked:
1. Yes it should be Monday
  2. I think so, have to check, seems identical
  3. Grep uses regex. Regex does not have automatic anchoring. That regex expression does not specify ^ and $. So it matches any substring starting with a and ending with e. To force only matches where entire file name starts with a and ends with e, either use anchoring in regex, or use shell glob (as per given answer) as it anchors by default
